lines: The caravans left things behind in this hall. Some of them are still here.
Come back any time. The lamps stay lit for travellers.
npcs.name: Vesper

trainer.name: Vesper
wait: The keepers of this hall test everyone first. I am afraid that includes you.
Speak with all three, and I will be waiting.
say: Welcome to the old caravanserai. Every lamp here was left burning for someone.
My Pokemon guard what the desert would rather forget.
Let us see whether you are the sort of trainer they remember.
say2: You came back. The hall noticed. Shall we?
lose: There. The lamps burn a little brighter for you now.
Take the Dunereach Badge. Carry it gently. Old things are heavier than they look.

lines: The candles say you can pass. They are never wrong.

trainer.name: Ines
trainer.say: Every candle in here has a name. Want to hear them? Battle me first!
trainer.lose: The candles say you can pass. They are never wrong.

lines: Buried again. That happens a lot to me.

trainer.name: Rami
trainer.say: I have dug up half this desert. Now let me dig into your team!
trainer.lose: Buried again. That happens a lot to me.

lines: Snuffed out. Go on, Miss Vesper is waiting.

trainer.name: Dov
trainer.say: I light every lamp at dusk and I have never missed one. Mind the flame!
trainer.lose: Snuffed out. Go on, Miss Vesper is waiting.

lines: Miss Vesper keeps the old relics of the caravans. Her Pokemon are slow, sturdy and hard to hurt.
Hit fast and hit often. Waiting games are what she wants.
